item.title: Road to be closed for some time following collision
item.description: Police are currently at the scene of a two vehicle collision at High Dyke, B6403, Londonthorpe. The road has been closed and police will be at the scene for some time. item.title: New owners of manor house near Grantham say they will explore its ‘full potential’
item.description: A historic manor house hotel in Lincolnshire has been sold for an undisclosed sum. Stoke Rochford Hall, a Jacobean-style property, near Grantham, is set within approximately 28 acres of landscaped gardens and woodlands.
